text.title: CLAUDE.md Creation — Worked Examples
text.summary: One complete record for a FastAPI service's CLAUDE.md built from the standard template, with a note on every value a reader might question, and one record for the first draft of the same file that breaks six subject rules and what the validator and the reviewer say about it.

section.title: Scenario
section.p: A new FastAPI service (`acme/intake-api`) has no CLAUDE.md. The first draft pasted the README, a `DATABASE_URL` with a real password, and `npm run test:unit` copied from another repo. The developer runs steps 1-8 of `content/04-procedure.xml` from `templates/claude-md-standard.md.j2` and commits the file whose record is below.

example.title: Complete record with resync check
example.code: { "repo": "acme/intake-api", "layout": "single", "template": "standard", "token_count": 480, "commands": [ {"command": "make dev", "source": "Makefile", "comment": "Start development server (port 8000)", "ran_ok": true}, {"command": "pytest --cov=src -x", "source": "pyproject.toml", "comment": "Run tests, stop at first failure", "ran_ok": true}, {"command": "ruff check . --fix", "source": "pyproject.toml", "comment": "Lint + auto-fix (rules: E/F/I/B/T20/DJ)", "ran_ok": true}, {"command": "mypy src", "source": "pyproject.toml", "comment": "Type check", "ran_ok": true}, {"command": "alembic upgrade head", "source": "Makefile", "comment": "Apply migrations", "ran_ok": true} ], "secrets_scan": {"tool": "gitleaks", "clean": true, "env_vars_by_name_only": true, "env_example_referenced": true}, "structure": [ {"path": "src/api/", "purpose": "FastAPI routes, v1/ per API version"}, {"path": "src/core/", "purpose": "Business logic, config, security helpers"}, {"path": "src/models/", "purpose": "SQLAlchemy models"}, {"path": "src/schemas/", "purpose": "Pydantic schemas"}, {"path": "tests/", "purpose": "unit/ mirrors src/, integration/ hits endpoints"} ], "key_files": [ {"path": "src/core/config.py", "purpose": "Settings read from env; nothing else reads env directly", "exists": true}, {"path": "src/api/deps.py", "purpose": "FastAPI dependencies (auth, db session)", "exists": true}, {"path": ".env.example", "purpose": "Required env vars; copy to .env before running", "exists": true} ], "gotchas": [ {"entry": "DATABASE_URL has no default; the app exits at startup without it", "names": "env-var"}, {"entry": "No print() in production code; ruff T20 blocks the commit", "names": "lint-rule"}, {"entry": "Run alembic upgrade head before first start or the health check returns 503", "names": "command"} ], "local_settings": {"personal_paths_grep_clean": true, "claude_local_md_gitignored": true}, "resync_check": {"kind": "ci-job", "location": ".github/workflows/claude-md-sync.yml", "fails_on_manifest_drift": true}, "evidence": [ "https://ci.example.com/acme/intake-api/runs/8812", "https://ci.example.com/acme/intake-api/runs/8812/gitleaks", "https://github.com/acme/intake-api/blob/main/.github/workflows/claude-md-sync.yml" ] }
example.note: `token_count` 480 against the standard template's 500: the architecture paragraph that pushed the first draft to 3,100 tokens now lives behind a one-line pointer to `docs/architecture.md`, and the commands were not trimmed to make room.

Every command names its manifest: `make dev` and `alembic upgrade head` from the Makefile, the rest from `pyproject.toml` tooling; all five ran on a clean checkout in CI run 8812, which is the first evidence URL.
`structure` has five entries, not the 40-line `tree` output: the purpose phrases are the information the agent cannot derive by listing the directory itself.
The `DATABASE_URL` gotcha names an env var and states the consequence (exits at startup); the ruff T20 gotcha names a lint rule. Neither is advice the model already knows.
`resync_check` is a CI job at `.github/workflows/claude-md-sync.yml`, linked as the third evidence URL, so a renamed Makefile target fails the build in the PR that renames it.
`layout` is single, so no `monorepo` block is present; the schema requires one only for a monorepo layout.

example.title: Six subject rules broken
example.note: What the validator prints: `token_count: 3100 is above maximum 500` for the standard template (r-token-budget-declared-and-held); `commands[0].ran_ok: False is not the required const True` on a command copied from another repo (r-commands-extracted-and-executed); `secrets_scan.clean: False`, `env_vars_by_name_only: False`, `env_example_referenced: False` (r-zero-secrets-env-by-name-only); `structure[0].path: 'node_modules/' matches the forbidden not schema` and the same for `dist/` (r-structure-lists-load-bearing-paths-only); `key_files[0].exists: False is not the required const True`; `gotchas[0].entry: 'Write clean code and add tests' matches the forbidden not schema` (r-gotchas-are-repo-specific); `local_settings.personal_paths_grep_clean: False` and `claude_local_md_gitignored: False` (r-personal-and-machine-specifics-stay-local); `resync_check.fails_on_manifest_drift: False` (r-commands-resync-on-manifest-change).

What the reviewer sees beyond the validator: the secret scan hit means the password is already in git history and must be rotated before the file is fixed (fm-secret-pasted-in); and `npm run test:unit` in a Python repo means the commands were never extracted from this repo's manifests at all. The draft goes back to step 2.

list.item: Run the commands before writing them down; the agent will run them on turn one of every session, and "believed to exist" is the failure mode.
The budget is held by splitting, never by trimming the commands; the pointer to `docs/architecture.md` costs one line and keeps the prose available on demand.
The resync check is what makes the file true next month; without it, the first renamed script starts the drift.
